input.summary: Extend Deliverable/software conformance warranty to twelve months (ninety days for Services) and delete the sunset of Vendor's correction and refund obligations.
input.comment: [Playbook] We extended the conformance warranty to twelve months for Deliverables and delivered software and ninety days for Services, and removed the clause cutting off Vendor's correction and refund obligations, which otherwise gutted the Section 19.4 remedy after fifteen days. Our playbook requires a meaningful warranty period with repair, replacement, re-performance or refund; we can discuss ninety days for software and thirty days for Services as a fallback.

ops.oldText: For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
ops.newText: For twelve months after delivery, each Deliverable and any software delivered to Customer will materially conform to its documentation, and for ninety days after performance the Services will materially conform to their documentation. For any nonconformity Customer reports during the applicable period, Vendor's correction, replacement, and refund obligations under Section 19.4 apply.
